experiments.hypothesis: Economically material usage is positively associated with network value.
Usage has a stronger valuation association when a live token-linked capture route is active.
Theory-defined function bundles explain valuation multiples better than an unweighted count of functions.
Greater staking participation reduces liquid float and is associated with lower turnover or greater trading frictions.
Activation or suspension of a value-accrual mechanism changes valuation or valuation multiples relative to unaffected controls.
Economic function predicts exposure to the common crypto market factor, realized volatility, and drawdown across the full universe.
experiments.registration_note: Frozen after six-asset descriptive sorts were observed and before any classification beyond the verified core was estimated; the full-universe test uses provisional codes and is labeled as such.

guardrails: Raw breadth and theory-defined bundles must be reported separately.
No function weights may be selected from the outcome being tested.
Mechanism states must be effective-dated and cannot be backfilled.
Architecture labels are controls or strata, not value-accrual outcomes.
The frozen exploratory H2 result used the older broad treasury-capture rule and is not relabeled as evidence under the strict Phase 1 rule.
